data.text: I’m in on the same conditions as John: 15 tons, with the full $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, if Kate and Emma also agree and Luke catches zero. My family taught me that this lake supports the village, and today our neighbors need its help. I’ll also commit to six tons next month so we can rebuild the stock, then ten tons each once it’s back to 100. Kate, can you join us on both the donation and the recovery plan?
